(`set/skills/principles`), MIT. Copied 2026-08-01.

Only the CODE-relevant subset is here. The judgement-oriented principles
(truth, meritocracy, ownership, transparency, ...) are for the supervisor and

(slice V6).

these files and regenerating -- `bbx slice --check` gates the drift.
